The '''New Republic Yavin orbital fleet''' was a fleet of military [[Starship/Legends|starships]] stationed over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in order to protect the [[Jedi Praxeum]] based on the surface. As part of this military presence, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] also had some guards stationed on the moon guarding the Praxeum hangar. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Anja Gallandro]] stole a freighter, the ''[[Lightning Rod]]'', and fled the moon. The fleet was not prepared to intercept someone leaving the moon, and so were unable to prevent her unauthorized departure.
